svg.title: dnachem-min: how Manifest.json is produced
svg.desc: Class and data-flow diagram of the Manifest feature: per-run capture (Run, PrimaryGeneratorAction, RunAction, RunAccumulator), per-dump assembly (RunAccumulatorMessenger, RunManifest, ManifestWriter) and the ManifestData data model.
svg.text: How Manifest.json is produced in dnachem-min
One Manifest.json is written beside the data files of every dump. Follow the numbered steps 1 to 11: from a /run/beamOn to the JSON file.

Totals (totalEvents, totalEnergyDeposit_eV) are not stored: ManifestWriter sums them from runs.
Every quantity carries its unit in its name, so no Geant4 unit system leaks into the data model.
